english.title: Undertake fishing operations in contravention of article 3, paragraph 1
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to article 3 of the Sea Fishing Operations (Monitoring Devices) (Wales) Order 2022 and section 5(4) of the Sea Fisheries Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
person in charge of
Welsh fishing boat / relevant fishing boat fish in Wales / the Welsh zone
which undertook fishing operations
without monitoring device being installed OR
when Welsh Ministers not notified of unique identification number of monitoring device OR
when Welsh Ministers not notified of name of fishing boat upon which device installed OR
when Welsh Ministers not notified of Fleet Register Number or IRCS of fishing boat OR
when monitoring device not transmitting required information to Welsh Ministers at least once in 10 minute period

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence only applies to certain fishing boats, see article 1 of the Sea Fishing Operations (Monitoring Devices) (Wales) Order 2022.
